title: Double-Crossover Attack
description: A quick crossover back-and-forth at the top of the key to wrong-foot the defender, then an attack to the rim or a pull-up.

content.objective: Make two crossovers in rhythm without raising the ball, then read the defender's weight to drive or pull up.
content.setup: Offense starts at the top of the key with a ball, defense one arm-length in front.
content.organization: Play live 1v1 after the move; switch roles each possession.
instructions: From triple threat, start a right-hand dribble toward the right slot.
Cross to the left hand, then immediately back to the right (two dribbles).
Read the defender: if they lean left, drive right to the rim.
If they drop back, pull up from the elbow.
Play the possession out against live defense.
coachingPoints: Both crossovers below the knee and quick.
Look at the rim, not the ball, during the move.
Commit to the read: drive or pull up, no extra dribbles.
commonMistakes: Crossing in front of the defender's reach.
Driving into a set defender instead of reading the lean.
content.safety: Defenders cannot slap down on the ball from above the shoulder.
progressions: Start from a live catch on the wing.
Add a help defender in the lane.
regressions: Walk the double crossover, then add speed.
Passive defender who leans on cue.
successCriteria: Correct decision (drive or pull up) in at least 7 of 10 tries.
content.gameApplication: A second change of hand catches defenders who react to the first one.
